rule: Every discovered field or measured anchor carries exactly one class. classifiedFieldsOrAnchors must equal discoveredFieldsOrAnchors; there is no unresolved bucket.

classes.participant_writable: The participant or a deterministic case fact owns this field and the factory may write it.
classes.protected: A court, clerk, prosecutor, attorney, agency or signature field. Never written, whatever anchor is supplied.
classes.not_applicable: Discovered on the form but outside this packet's participant set, so nothing is written and nothing is claimed.

denominator: measured anchors plus deliberately unbound captions

entries.label: Email Address
entries.basis: writable as participant.email but this form's packet binds no value to it
entries.why: Writable and now correctly resolved to participant.email -- the shared module's ordering defect, which sent it to participant.street_address, is fixed and guarded. It stays unbound here for a different reason: this rule carries two blanks, 'Email Address' and 'Telephone Number', on one 220.61pt line, and where the first ends is not drawn. Writing an email across the whole rule would run it under the telephone caption.

entries.label: Telephone Number
entries.basis: writable as participant.phone but this form's packet binds no value to it
entries.why: Writable and correct in semantics, but no telephone fact is part of this form's approved participant set; left for the participant.

entries.label: Date
entries.why: Refused by semantics: no allowlisted fact matches. This is the participant's signing date and is not ours to guess.

entries.label: State Bar No. (if any)
entries.why: Refused by semantics as an attorney field.
